item.title: Pocket TTS in Basque: real-time speech synthesis on a plain CPU
item.description: Pocket TTS adapted to Basque: real-time speech synthesis on a plain CPU, with voice cloning, trained on a 470-hour synthetic dataset.

item.title: Hiding personal data in Basque texts
item.description: Adapting GLiNER2 to Basque to detect personal data (names, phone numbers, addresses, IDs...) in texts: an extra layer of protection.

item.title: Dictating in Basque on mobile, without sending your voice anywhere
item.description: A Basque Whisper model for FUTO Keyboard: dictate in Basque on your phone, with everything running on the device and no audio sent anywhere.

item.title: Basque predictive text on mobile, respecting privacy
item.description: A small Basque language model for FUTO Keyboard: next-word prediction and autocorrect on Android, while respecting your privacy.

item.title: Identifying Basque dialects
item.description: NongoEuskara: a fastText model that guesses which Basque dialect a text is written in, running in the browser via WebAssembly.

item.title: Which language model performs best in Basque?
item.description: EvalEU: an open ranking that measures and compares how well local language models (Latxa, Kimu, Qwen, Gemma...) handle Basque.

item.title: Antzoki-TTS: Adding Emotion and Acting Capabilities
item.description: Antzoki-TTS: a LoRA trained on top of DramaBox to generate emotional, expressive Basque synthetic voices guided by script-style prompts.

item.title: New Text-to-Speech Models for Basque: Maider, Antton and OmniVoice
item.description: New Basque text-to-speech models: HiTZ's Maider and Antton voices for Piper TTS, and OmniVoice, which can synthesize over 600 languages.

item.title: Nvidia Parakeet in Basque: fast and CPU-friendly
item.description: Nvidia Parakeet fine-tuned for Basque: a lightweight speech recognition model that runs fast on modest hardware and CPUs.

item.title: TrikuSec
item.description: TrikuSec: an open-source platform that collects and tracks Lynis security audits from many servers in a single dashboard.

item.title: Convert Models to GGUF Format
item.description: A guide to converting Hugging Face models to GGUF with llama.cpp, so you can run them locally with Ollama or Llama.cpp.

item.title: New Latxa VL Models
item.description: Testing HiTZ's small Latxa VL models: describing images in Basque and, above all, extracting text from them as OCR.

item.title: Kimu
item.description: Orai's Kimu Basque language models (2B and 9B, based on Gemma 2), converted to GGUF and run locally with Ollama.

item.title: Real-time Transcriptions in Basque
item.description: An experiment in real-time Basque transcription for live talks, using Basque Whisper models and the whisper-streaming project.

item.title: Basque from speech to text: improving transcription models
item.description: Improving Basque Whisper models with Common Voice, OpenSLR and Basque Parliament data: whisper-small-eu's WER dropped from 11.84% to 7.63%.

item.title: GitHub Copilot Agent Mode: An Intelligent Development Partner
item.description: Trying GitHub Copilot's Agent Mode: an autonomous development assistant that analyzes, edits and runs your project's files, even in Basque.

item.title: Local RAG in Basque using Tülu 3
item.description: A local RAG system in Basque with Tülu 3 70B, Ollama and Open-WebUI: chat with your documents, with everything running on your machine.

item.title: New blog
item.description: Hi! A new blog to write about the technologies I learn and try out, built with Hugo.
